## **[Network Services](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/3650-decent-partners-an-introduction-to-network-services)**
Decent Partners

**Project Summary **
This proposal seeks funding for the ongoing development of Kabocha runtime, setup maintenance and support from Elio who has been working on the project for the past few months.

Elio has been funded to date by the Edgeware Agency who advanced funds ahead of a formalised proposal. This proposal seeks to reimburse the agency and to also fund Elio as a core member of Kabocha’s dev team.

When Kabocha has launched, it is expected that Elio will be funded via a new KAB proposal. 

## **Work to date**

_01.12.2021 - 01.02.2022_

Adding pallets in to the Kabocha runtime, debugging and repo maintenance (updated versions in line with Polkadot releases).

## **About Elio**

([Initial introduction post here](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/2849-enthusiast-contributor)) 

My name is Elio. I have a master's degree in computer science and I have more than 6 years experience as a professional software developer in Android/Java developer in the market. I have been deeply fascinated by blockchain and discovered Substrate after learning Solidity. I have spent the the past 12 months learning Rust/Substrate. 

I am a contributor to the Substrate repo, taking it upon myself to upgrading Substrate “Kitchen Node” Recipes from v1 to v2, which took 5-6 months working in my spare time.
 
Pull request link: [https://github.com/JoshOrndorff/recipes/pull/471](https://github.com/JoshOrndorff/recipes/pull/471)
